name: Pig Phatz BBQ
phone_conflict: Garden City Chamber listing shows (620) 295-0113 and an older address, 210 E Spruce St. Most sources use 207 N Main St and (620) 640-1007.
hours_conflict: VisitGCK: Thursday-Sunday. Yelp: Tuesday-Sunday. Garden City Downtown Vision: closed Sat & Sun. Confirm with the owner.
review_mentions: Catering kept food warm for hours

reviews.quote: The best BBQ I've ever eaten. The brisket is amazing, as are the burnt ends.
reviews.author: Carlos N.

reviews.quote: I've been looking for good pork belly for quite some time. I finally found it at Pig Phatz!
reviews.author: Adam S.

reviews.quote: Beth's cobbler is nothing short of amazing.
reviews.author: Roman S.

reviews.quote: Fantastic food, cooked perfectly and quickly! The portion sizes are huge!
reviews.author: Chris O.

reviews.quote: Ate there three times in my week-plus stay in Garden City and it's simply the best.
reviews.author: Sharkabrah Productions

reviews.quote: They catered an event I helped with - so professional and easygoing. The food was incredibly delicious.
reviews.author: Robyn M.

reviews.quote: The Mac n cheese is so creamy... the pork belly is juicy and flavorful.
reviews.author: Kristie M.

reviews.quote: Great pit stop on our way through Kansas. Awesome ribs and great brisket!
reviews.author: Kyle B.
